entry.title: deploy: fix GHCR publish source copy in job containers (#66)
entry.content:
deploy: fix GHCR publish source copy in job containers (#66)

Job containers default to Debian sh (dash), which rejects set -o pipefail
and aborted Place sources at /src before the copy ran. Use bash and a tar
pipe so cargo still builds from a real /src tree for ServeDir.

Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>

entry.content:

* CI: add ci.yml (fmt/clippy/test/build + relative lychee)

Build the root Containerfile in Actions with GHA layer cache, then run
edition 2024, fmt, clippy -D warnings, test, build, and offline lychee
inside that image. Cache Cargo via Swatinem/rust-cache. Set SQLX_OFFLINE
when .sqlx/ is present. Install jq in the CI image for the edition gate.

Keep the GitHub check name as "checks" so later steps can be added
without renaming a required status. Use latest majors: checkout v7,
setup-buildx-action v4, build-push-action v7; rust-cache stays on v2.
